section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the factor structure and validity of a Romanian translation of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2). The study found a one-dimensional factor structure for the BAS-2 in both women and men, though with some gender differences in factor loadings. Notably, the BAS-2 did not demonstrate full sex invariance across genders, which the authors identify as a novel finding compared to previous research. The study also reports that BAS-2 scores were significantly and negatively correlated with BMI and disordered eating symptoms, and positively correlated with self-esteem, life satisfaction, and happiness. The sample consisted of Romanian university students, limiting generalizability to the broader population.
